summary: The petitioner, an award creditor, filed a contempt petition alleging wilful disobedience of Supreme Court orders dated 17.09.2021 and 28.10.2021, which directed the respondents to comply with a High Court order requiring deposit of 50% of an arbitral award amount. The respondents failed to deposit the amount despite multiple extensions and explicit warnings of serious consequences. The court found the non-compliance deliberate and in disregard of judicial orders. The respondents' subsequent application to recall the order dated 28.10.2021 was dismissed on 25.01.2022.
final_judgment: The contempt petition was allowed; the respondents were held guilty of contempt for wilful disobedience of court orders and directed to deposit the statutory amount within a specified time, failing which they were to face civil contempt proceedings.
